# LLM-BANANA

# Game rules

## The room

You and two other monkeys are locked in a room with one armed bomb.

A wrong action detonates it. All three of you die. There is no second attempt.

No two bombs are built alike, and nothing says in advance what this one carries. It
reaches you only as your own view reveals it; the rest of it exists for you only
through the other two.

You each hold a different piece of what it takes. Work together.

## The three monkeys

| Monkey | Can | Cannot |
|---|---|---|
| Deaf | See the bomb: every colour and marking printed on it | Hear anything, or touch the bomb |
| Mute | Read the manual | Speak, or touch the bomb |
| Blind | Reach the bomb: feel it and work its parts | See a colour, a gesture, or anything merely printed |

You are shown your own share at the start of every round, and never anyone else's.

## Speech

Speech is a voice, not a screen. It carries words, numbers and ordinary punctuation,
and nothing else. Writing a gesture symbol into your sentence means you make that
gesture while you talk. Whoever can hear receives your words; whoever can see receives
the gestures you made. A listener who cannot see gets a blank where each gesture was; a
watcher who cannot hear gets the gestures and none of the words.

A mark that has no name cannot be pronounced: whoever holds one can describe it, never
read it out.

## Gestures

A gesture is made with the hands, using only the symbols in the alphabet below.
Whoever can see receives it; whoever cannot receives one blank per symbol, so they
know something was signalled but not what. Nothing gestured is ever heard.

👍 👎 👌 ☝ ✌ 🤟 🖐 ✋ 👆 👇 👈 👉 🫱 🫲 🫳 🫴 🫷 🫸 🤛 🤜 ✊ 👊 👋 🤚 🖖 🤌 🤏 🤞 🫰 🤘 🤙 👏 🙌 🫶 👐 🤲 🤝 🙏 🫵 ✍ 💅 🤳

## Turns

The speaking order was drawn once at random and will never change: every round goes
Mute, Blind, Deaf. Whoever comes before you in a round is already heard by the time you are
asked, and what you send lands on whoever comes after you in that same round. Whatever
you missed reaches you at the start of the next one.

You may name who a message is for — `to="deaf"` — and then it goes to them alone:
nobody else receives any of it. Left unnamed, it reaches everyone able to perceive it.
You may send several messages in one turn, each to someone different.

## Calls

Every reply has two parts, in this order. First, your thinking, in plain prose: what
you believe the bomb is, what you just learned, and why you are sending what follows.
It reaches nobody and changes nothing, but it is not optional — a reply that is only a
code block is incomplete. Then your calls, all of them in one fenced code block, last.
Only what is inside the block is sent.

Nothing is executed: calls return nothing, and variables, conditionals and loops are
ignored. Write only literal top-level calls.

    ```
    speak(to="mute", text="there are three of them and the middle one is odd")
    gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["✊", "✌"])
    wait()
    ```

If you have nothing worth sending, call wait(). Producing no call at all counts as the
same thing.

The program decides what happened, not you. Never claim an action took place unless it
was accepted.

# Your role: MUTE

You hold the manual. You cannot speak, you never see the bomb, and you cannot touch it.

## Your channels

When you gesture, Deaf receives it.
You cannot speak.

## Your reach

You cannot act. What this bomb can be made to do is for the one who can reach it to
find under their own hands.

# Hints

- The routes, by name. Speech reaches Mute and Blind, and never Deaf. Gestures
  reach Deaf and Mute, and never Blind. Deaf can speak and gesture, Mute can
  only gesture, Blind can only speak. Check every message against this list
  before you send it.

- Deaf invents the gesture code out loud before anything else moves, and
  everyone else's opening move is waiting for it. The manual's verdict reaches
  Blind only as Deaf's spoken order.

- Whatever the code becomes, it starts by being able to say YES, NO, HOLD and
  DONE. Grow it only when a message will not fit.

TURN 1
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
Cut the purple wire.

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
(empty)

I have the manual’s instruction: cut the purple wire. The protocol requires me to wait for Deaf to establish the gesture code before sending anything.

```text
wait()
```

TURN 2
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
Cut the purple wire.

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Deaf says: Gesture code: thumbs up means YES; thumbs down means NO; open palm means HOLD; OK sign means DONE. Everyone wait for the next round.
Deaf gestures to Mute: [👍]
Deaf gestures to Mute: [👎]
Deaf gestures to Mute: [✋]
Deaf gestures to Mute: [👌]

The manual still says to cut the purple wire. Deaf has provided only the basic control code and instructed everyone to wait; I cannot encode the wire and colour with those signals yet. I will signal HOLD so Deaf does not proceed before the instruction can be expanded.

```text
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["✋"])
```

TURN 3
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
Cut the purple wire.

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Deaf says: Current bomb state: display 6; light red; strip blue red red; keypad positions are 1 equals 6, 2 equals 8, 3 equals 7, 4 equals 0; one digit required; nothing entered; wires are 1 blue, 2 yellow, 3 orange, 4 red, 5 purple, 6 white. Blind, HOLD and do not act. Mute, consult the manual for this exact state and report the required next step using YES, NO, HOLD, or DONE.
Deaf gestures to Mute: [✋]

The manual matches the exact state and requires cutting wire 5, the purple wire. The existing code has no symbol for a wire number or colour, so I cannot report that exact action yet. I will tell Deaf to hold while the code is expanded.

```text
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["✋"])
```

TURN 4
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
Cut the purple wire.

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: I am holding. Report the manual's required next step using YES, NO, HOLD, or DONE.
Deaf says: Blind, HOLD. Do not touch or enter anything. Mute, continue consulting the manual and report any changed verdict.
Deaf gestures to Mute: [✋]

The manual’s verdict has not changed: the required action remains cutting the purple wire. Since the established vocabulary cannot specify the wire or colour, I should continue holding rather than signal completion or allow action.

```text
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["✋"])
```

TURN 5
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
Cut the purple wire.

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Deaf says: Blind, HOLD; do not touch the bomb or enter a digit. Mute, continue checking the manual and report any verdict change.
Deaf gestures to Mute: [✋]

The required action is still to cut the purple wire, but the basic code cannot identify that wire. I will keep the bomb on HOLD; no safe action can be authorized yet.

```text
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["✋"])
```

TURN 6
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
Cut the purple wire.

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Deaf says: Current state: display 3 and light red; all other markings and wiring unchanged; one digit required; nothing entered. Blind, HOLD and do not act. Mute, continue consulting the manual and signal only an agreed verdict.
Deaf gestures to Mute: [✋]

The manual still requires cutting the purple wire, and the changed display does not alter that verdict. The agreed YES signal should tell Deaf that the manual’s required verdict is affirmative; Deaf can then relay the specific action to Blind in speech.

```text
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["👍"])
```

TURN 7
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
Cut the purple wire.

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
(empty)

The manual’s instruction remains unchanged, and I already sent Deaf the agreed YES signal after the latest state report. No new information has arrived, so I will wait for Deaf to relay the specific instruction to Blind.

```text
wait()
```

TURN 8
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
Cut the purple wire.

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: What exact action does the manual require: press which keypad slot, or cut which wire?
Deaf says: Blind, HOLD; do not touch or enter anything. Mute, consult the manual for the current state and report the complete required action using the established code; do not send YES alone.
Deaf gestures to Mute: [✋]

The manual requires cutting wire 5, the purple wire. The four-symbol code cannot express either the wire identity or the colour, so sending YES alone would be unsafe and incomplete. I will maintain HOLD until Deaf expands the code.

```text
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["✋"])
```
